title: Colony and Signal
author: Hazel Reyes
blurb: Zephyrine Whitlock, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
